description: Post or update the grade for one student's submission on a regular assignment and return the updated Canvas submission object (score, grade, workflow_state, graded_at). Only `grade` is sent; nothing else on the submission changes. Idempotent: calling it again with the same grade string overwrites the previous `posted_grade` rather than creating a second grade. This sets only the top-level grade — for a rubric-based assignment use submit_rubric_assessment to score each criterion instead, and for a Classic Quiz use score_quiz_question to grade one question at a time rather than the assignment as a whole. Requires grading permission in the course.
name: grade_submission
title: Grade Submission
